rules.name: MoonBit default review rule
rules.content:
## Correctness
Is the MoonBit logic correct? Are there missing boundary conditions (empty input, NaN propagation, Map lookups returning None)?
Are exceptions handled properly (try/catch coverage, async behavior)?
Is the engine state mutation thread-safe in concurrent scenarios?

## Security
Are there security vulnerabilities? Is sensitive information logged (api keys, raw user input)?
Is the read_json_body size limit enforced? Is serve_static path-traversal protected?

## Performance
Are there obvious performance issues (O(N*M) full-graph scans, repeated to_json serialization)?
Are resources properly released (ref / StringBuilder / Array)?
Does the function avoid unnecessary Map iteration?

## Maintainability
Is the code clear and easy to understand? Do names accurately express intent?
Does it follow the project's existing code style and architecture patterns (e.g. D1-D8 module names)?
Is the function signature idiomatic MoonBit (pub fn Struct::method(self, ...) -> ReturnType)?

## Determinism (project-specific hard contract)
Is the function deterministic? Same input -> byte-identical output?
Does it use logical clock (self.clock) instead of wall-clock time?
Does it avoid random number generation?

## Test Coverage
Do critical logic paths have corresponding test cases?
Do test cases cover boundary conditions (empty input, max input, NaN)?
